        },
        "error_message": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 0,

            "type": "object",

                    "minLength": 0,

                },
                "id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9:_\\-]+$",
                    "minLength": 0,
                    "maxLength": 255
                },
                "tag": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^([\\w\\/-]|[\\w-][\\w\\/-]*[\\w-])$",
                    "minLength": 0,
                    "maxLength": 255
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "curie",
                "id"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false

        "message": {

        },

            "type": "object",

                }
            },
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "@link https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HATEOAS"
        }
    },
    "required": [
        "_schema",
        "envelope_id"
    ],
    "additionalProperties": false
